identity: Film actor and film director · United Kingdom · 1889–1977
title: Charlie Chaplin's birth chart
metaDescription: Charlie Chaplin's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 26.7° Aries. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 26.7° Aries, in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 26.7° Aries — deep enough in the third decan (20°–30°) that Jupiter, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Aries (17.1°), Venus in Taurus (18.2°), Mars in Taurus (13.3°): thought that arrives already in motion, attraction that grows by reliability, effort banked steadily until it tells.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Mars and Saturn — a square holding at 0.1°. A square is the tradition’s engine room: two drives at cross purposes, and the friction is the horsepower. Behind it, Mercury opposition Uranus at 2.5°, and Mercury trine Saturn at 3.7° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags five placements in this chart. The Sun in Aries at 26.7° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Taurus at 18.2° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mars in Taurus at 13.3° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Capricorn at 8.2° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Saturn in Leo at 13.4° is in detriment. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 3 fire, 3 earth, 3 air by element and 4 cardinal, 3 fixed, 2 mutable by mode. No settled placement falls in water — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Venus and Uranus were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Libra into Scorpio during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.7° between one midnight and the next. A birth time would settle it in a second; there isn’t one. So the Moon stays unnamed here — the alternative is a guess wearing the clothes of a fact.
